name: SA-1B: Segment Anything 1-Billion Dataset
description: SA-1B (Segment Anything 1-Billion) is the largest segmentation dataset ever compiled, featuring 11 million high-resolution, privacy-protected natural images and 1.1 billion high-quality segmentation masks generated by Meta's Segment Anything Model (SAM) with human-in-the-loop validation. Spanning diverse geographic regions and complex natural scenes, it serves as the foundational pretraining resource for promptable visual segmentation.

license.name: SA-1B Dataset Research License Agreement
license.notes: The SA-1B dataset is restricted to non-commercial research purposes under the SA-1B Research License; model code/weights are under Apache 2.0.

verification.notes: Verified download availability via research agreement, 11M image and 1.1B mask count, and ICCV 2023 publication.
